Medium close-up from a slightly elevated angle, 85mm macro lens, 16:9 composition. Scarlett (Image 1) stands at the black stone sink, holding the closed coral lipstick upright in both hands beside her mouth, thumb poised beneath the casing just before the decisive twist, weight settled toward the vanity and eyes fixed on the mirror. Her lips and hands dominate the foreground, while the mirror catches a partial reflection and leaves open space toward the sink for the next application. Compact contemporary bathroom with white tiled walls and restrained counter details. Hard morning sunlight cuts diagonally across tile and sink, catching the metal casing with a crisp highlight. Clean, bright, tactile editorial product photography, natural color, shallow focus, airy shadows.

Reference images define identity — keep every referenced character, object, and location consistent with its reference image; never render a reference image itself as a separate panel or subject.
